title: Legal Administrator
description:
Paralegal (temporary)

Venn Group's specialist Private Practice Legal Recruitment team is recruiting a temporary Paralegal for a highly regarded law firm in York. The role offers an excellent opportunity to broaden your legal experience and would suit someone who is immediately available on a full-time basis and has previous legal experience within a law firm.

The role

You will be responsible for:
- Acting as the primary contact for clients, ensuring smooth and efficient transaction progress by facilitating communication between clients, fee earners, and support staff
- The position supports a wide range of legal settings, combining fee-earning and administrative duties such as managing caseloads, drafting legal documents, reviewing case materials, and preparing or distributing financial records
- The potential to progress a broad range of commercial property plot sales matters from instruction to completion

About you
- The ideal candidate will have previous experience providing administrative support to a busy Commercial Property plot sales team within private practice, however general legal experience may also be considered.

Key details
- Hourly rate: £12.71 - £14.00 per hour
- Location: York
- Contract: Temporary
- Start: Week commencing 5th October
- Initial length of assignment: Week commencing 5th October - 27th November with the potential of extension

title: Paralegal
company: LSL Property Services plc - Agency - Permanent
description:
LSL is a one of the largest providers of services to mortgage intermediaries, specialist mortgage and protection advice to estate agency and new build customers and valuation services to the UK's biggest mortgage lenders. It also operates a network of owned and franchised estate agency branches.

Based within our Group Legal Team in York, we are looking to recruit a Paralegal to provide support to the Group Legal Team with a wide variety of matters spanning across all areas of the LSL Group.

Location: York - on site office-based.

Role Purpose

To provide legal and administrative support to the Legal Team, assisting with a broad range of legal matters and ensuring the efficient delivery of legal services across the business. The role supports solicitors, contract administration, regulatory compliance, and corporate transactions whilst maintaining high standards of accuracy and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct legal research and prepare summaries, reports, and recommendations.
- Draft, review, and amend legal documents, including contracts, NDAs, agreements, and correspondence.
- Support solicitors and legal professionals on commercial, corporate, regulatory, and dispute resolution matters.
- Assist with contract management, document control, and legal record keeping.
- Monitor legal deadlines and maintain case and matter tracking systems.
- Prepare documentation for corporate transactions and business projects.
- Support regulatory and compliance activities.
- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external legal advisers where required.
- Assist with updating policies, procedures, and customer-facing terms and conditions.
- Ensure confidential information is handled appropriately at all times.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
- Law degree, Legal Practice qualification, or equivalent legal education.
- Previous paralegal experience desirable but not essential.
- Strong legal research and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal document management systems.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of legal risk.

Key Competencies
- Analytical thinking
- Attention to detail
- Professional integrity
- Communication and influencing
- Organisation and planning
- Problem solving
- Teamwork and collaboration
- Customer and stakeholder focus

Apply

If you feel you match our requirements and are looking for your next career challenge, or for a confidential discussion on the full details of this role please contact Alka Tarafdar

title: Part Time Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A well-established organisation in York is seeking a part-time Finance Administrator to join their finance team on a temporary basis while they recruit permanently.This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking for flexible hours and immediate work within a supportive team environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing purchase invoices and supplier payments
- Raising sales invoices and allocating receipts
- Supporting bank reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate financial records and databases
- Resolving finance-related queries from suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Assisting with month-end administration
- General finance and office administration duties as required

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in a Finance Administrator, Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant role
- Good understanding of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Confident using finance systems and Microsoft Excel
- Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively

What's on Offer
- Part-time hours of 21 per week
- Flexible working pattern available
- Immediate start
- Temporary assignment with the potential to run whilst a permanent recruitment process is completed
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- York-based office location

title: Patient Services Advisor (Receptionist)
location: York, YO32 2LL, York, YO24 3BU, Huntington, YO32 9RU, York, YO32 4AG, York, YO26 6EQ
description: PREVIOUS APPLICANTS NEED NOT APPLY. -- Please note interviews for this position will be held on Thursday 05 November 2026 -- Are you looking for a more fulfilling career? One that gives you a sense of achievement knowing that each day you are helping people access the healthcare that they need? If this sounds like you, we have the perfect opportunity for you! We are looking for individuals who to join our Patient Services Team who: Are enthusiastic and self-motivated Are able to use their initiative Excellent communicators, both written and verbal Are able to listen and empathise Are keen to learn and develop Demonstrate attention to detail Can be flexible and adaptable Are competent with IT In the role of Patient Services Advisor, you will receive, assist, and direct patients in accessing the appropriate services or healthcare professionals in a courteous, efficient, and effective way whether this be face to face or over the telephone. You will also undertake a variety of administrative tasks to assist with the smooth running of the practice. In return you will receive: Full induction and training plan Named direct Line Manager Long service rewards Generous holiday entitlement Wellbeing health plan Staff wellbeing group Ride to work scheme Uniform allowance Refreshments Support to develop your skills and career Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the General Manager, dependent on current and evolving workload and staffing levels: Opening up/locking-up of Practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with Practice protocols. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system. Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring patients are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Answer internal and external telephone calls when required. Participate in evening and Saturday morning working as per the standard rota. Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail. Taking messages and passing on information. Filing and retrieving paperwork. Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with Practice guidelines. Assist the Team Leader with routine site maintenance and Health and Safety. Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers. Clear and re-stock consulting rooms as required. Dealing with samples. Providing clerical assistance to Practice and Trust staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning. Ordering, re-ordering and monitoring of stationery and other supplies. Dealing with clinical waste. Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required; loading and emptying the dishwasher and keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy. Keeping the reception area, notice-boards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter. Helping to maintain hygiene control measures. Dealing with the front-desk administration and cash handling required for non-NHS work such as patients private insurance and medical reports.
